description.narrative: (India): Working with USAID, the Government of India (GOI) and local.public and private sector stakeholders, the Samagra activity will create an.urban health ecosystem that is responsive, affordable, and equitable, and which.provides quality preventive, promotive, and curative primary health care for.the urban poor, with a focus on women, girls, and other vulnerable populations..The Samagra program will create a total market for comprehensive, consumer-empowered.primary health... ..With FY 2022 funds, USAID will continue improving family.planning (FP), maternal and child health (MCH) services, and TB care for the.urban poor, with a special focus on women, girls, and other vulnerable.populations. The activity will: (1) Provide technical assistance at the.national, state, and city levels to strengthen urban health systems to ensure RMNCH+A,.and TB service delivery to vulnerable populations; (2) Manage sub-grants under.an accelerator hub to rapidly scale up proven urban health models; and (3).Under an incubator hub, test new models that deliver quality and affordable FP,.MCH, and TB services to the urban poor and vulnerable populations... ..As COVID-19 pandemic negatively affected poor urban.communities, this activity will layer on infectious disease prevention.education activities, like maintaining social distance, sanitizing service.points, and maintaining personal hygiene, while ensuring uninterrupted FP, MCH.and TB services in the intervention cities... ..The activity will adopt a collaborative learning and.adaptive management approach across all activity streams..
